01_repository_summary.title: Repository Summary
01_repository_summary.what_repository_does: Main wiki with business description and objectives. The Cloud Resource Scanner consolidates information from multiple AWS accounts and GCP projects into Prometheus metrics for alerting and dashboarding. From AWS accounts, it scans IAM keys, NAT Gateway IP addresses, and certificate expiration dates. From GCP projects, it scans IAM keys and certificate expiration dates. The Cloud Resource Scanner is responsible for the data behind these 3 dashboards: 1. https://prod-grafana-us-east-2.helios-prod.nbcuni.com/d/certificate-inventory 2. https://prod-grafana-us-east-2.helios-prod.nbcuni.com/d/ip-inventory 3. https://prod-grafana-us-east-2.helios-prod.nbcuni.com/d/user-key-inventory 4. https://prod-grafana-us-east-2.helios-prod.nbcuni.com/d/compliance-summary The Cloud Resource Scanner runs using the arn:aws:iam::608746997981:role/cloud-resource-scanner IAM Role.
